legend_notes: A6 INTERNALIZE is empty: component_init.py:245-249 hardcodes act_mem=None, para_mem=None. P-TRANSMUTE, the primitive this paper exists to introduce, has zero code path.
The storage split runs backwards from the docs: Neo4jCommunityGraphDB pops `embedding` out of every node's metadata and ships it straight to Qdrant — vectors never touch Neo4j (C47).
The write-side reader is MultiModalStructMemReader, not SimpleStructMemReader as documented — 4 parallel LLM channels per scene (fact/tool/skill/preference), not "one call per window" (C15, C20).

Three mechanisms that look load-bearing are quietly dead: the reranker's level_weight is inert (level_field="background" always the same value, C85), BM25/fulltext both default off, and the "prefer chat_time" timestamp fix always falls back to created_at because chat_time never leaves metadata.sources[] (C106).
